description: Defines the ContentType class for parsing and handling content-type headers, including strategies for text, JSON, and binary types, with constants and methods for content-type analysis within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Represents and parses content-type header values, providing methods to determine content type category and strategy.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Parses a string into a ContentType instance, determining the parsing strategy based on the media type.

methods.name: getParsingStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy for parsing the content based on content-type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the original content-type string value.

methods.name: isDittoProtocol
methods.description: Checks if the content-type matches the Ditto protocol content type.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as text.

methods.name: isJson
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as JSON.

methods.name: isBinary
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as binary.
